city_served.value: Served — one of the 24 South Carolina towns confirmed served (Brand Guide Section E)

local_context.value: Yemassee is split between Hampton and Beaufort counties by the CSX railroad line, most residents in Hampton County, about 44 miles north of Savannah and 54 miles west of Charleston; mean July high 90.1 F, about 53.6 inches of rain a year; Hampton County: 19.8% of residents 65+ (2020), 100% rural.

neighborhoods.value: No subdivision list found. Historic plantations inside town limits: Bindon, Cotton Hall, Tomotley (latter two annexed 2021); Pocotaligo (now part of Yemassee)

place_entities.value: Auldbrass Plantation (Frank Lloyd Wright-designed, just outside town); Yemassee Amtrak station; Hampton Regional Medical Center (Varnville, in Hampton County)
place_entities.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Auldbrass_Plantation (Wikipedia, read 2026-10-14) · https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yemassee_station (Wikipedia, read 2026-10-14) · https://www.hamptonregional.org/ (Hampton Regional Medical Center, read 2026-10-14)

permit_office.value: Hampton County Building Department (201 Jackson Ave West, Hampton SC; 803-914-2127) issues residential building permits; town approval (water/sewer, zoning) comes first. Beaufort County portion not checked. Town of Yemassee site blocked (403) so its own role was not confirmed
